notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD (mock strategy only; decision family-config and helper GymnasiumDriver are unchanged): RetroEnv is a Gymnasium environment, so the family shape is right, but the card's preferred upstream-sim backend was not usable. stable-retro registers no gymnasium.make id (its factory is stable_retro.make(game), stable_retro/__init__.py:56-72), the extension modules, cores and ROMs are not installed where the gate runs, and package code never imports the clone; the package therefore serves the pure Python fake (backends {'fake': '.fake:FakeRetroEnv'}) only, and the sim backend was not run. The fake returns a flat 60-element uint8 stand-in for an RGB frame; the real observation is an H x W x C uint8 image from emulator.get_screen() cropped by data.crop_info (stable_retro/retro_env.py:157-161, 333-351), and the clone fixes no pixel shape because it depends on the core and the game. Fake constants are test data, marked '# placeholder', and were not copied into a Fact, a Limit or the reference. Not covered: no emulator core, game data, ROM handling, savestate or rendering is modelled, and the fake was never compared with the upstream emulator; reset(seed) seeds gymnasium's RNG, not the emulator (retro_env.py:261-267). Five warnings are expected of this family: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (seed twice, ticks, action.values). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
